{{Quote|Talus – city of Dearic: Another capital city plagued by dirty politics and scandal, Dearic is also home to a diverse and bustling Starport. Control of this city provides a broad spectrum of intelligence that will span the entire galaxy.|[[Ysanne Isard]], [[Imperial Naval Communiqué 31756]]|<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1043532|text=Star Wars Galaxies™ Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege (Game Update 15)}}</ref>}}
'''Dearic''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Description==
Dearic held the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] on Talus, and was one of the most active cities in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. New arrivals to Talus were typically processed through this city. The city provided numerous import and export services for locals. Due to its location in the southern portion of Talus, Dearic was also an excellent staging ground for excursions into the planet's wilder regions.<ref name="SWG:D" />

At first glance, Dearic appeared to be a beautiful, bustling utopia. All three of the world's native, sentient species seemed to coexist peacefully. The city also seemed to lack rampant poverty or crime. Public services operated smoothly, and the residents appeared happy and healthy. In reality, however, Dearic was far from perfect. Its idyllic parks concealed violent thugs, and tensions between the [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], and [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] were on the rise. Likewise, because Dearic served as the capital for the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]], the city had a highly politicized atmosphere. With this, the city was plagued by corruption and scandal, and the populace was largely controlled by wealthy, uncaring and unscrupulous Fed-Dub officials.<ref name="SWG:D" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Talus remained largely neutral and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] allowed Fed-Dub to operate independently, while still monitoring the planet for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity.<ref name="SWG:T">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Starting Location: "Talus"</ref> However, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dearic had become a hotspot in the conflict and was the site of the [[Invasion of Dearic]].<ref name="SWG:GU15">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 15: Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege</ref>

Still, the city had a fair share of entertaining events for its citizens. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it hosted a large [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration.<ref name="SWG:WLD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Wookiee Life Day}}</ref>

==Residents==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin: [[Champhra Biahin]], [[Hagrin Zeed]], [[Haleen Snowline]], [[Kathikiis Ruwahurr]], [[Nurla Slinthiss]], [[Radlee Mathiss]],<ref name="SWG" /> [[Extok Evin]],<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> [[Mort]],<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> [[Omkoo]], [[Wire]],<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> [[Dathnaeya Loessin]], [[Vayde Quellium]], [[Braedic Ekirk]],<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> and [[Sul Prine]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dearic appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dearic was one of [[Nashal|only two]] permanent, non-player built cities on Talus. However, there was a third game-owned settlement which existed in the form of an [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]].<ref name="SWG" />

During the Life Day live event from [[December 16]], [[2008]] to [[January 12]], [[2009]], players could visit Dearic for a variety of Life Day activities. For the event, Dearic had a blizzard which covered the city in snow.<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68147&month=122008|text=Friday Feature – ''Corellia Times'' Exclusive: Life Day Revealed}}</ref>
